text: The walls of Lilmoth are a short walk east-north-east of here, about a hundred paces. Hereguard Plantation, which Bretons hold, is a little further the other way, west-south-west. Flaa Heet's village is a longer walk to the south-east.
Lilmoth is built over shallow water, so large ships cannot dock. They anchor out, and small boats bring the goods in.
Lilmoth has no single ruler. A council of powerful merchants governs it. It has its own Hist tree, though no tribe of its own.
I fish the shallows below the walls, out among the lily pads, and sell my catch inside. I live outside the walls because the rent inside is more than fish pay.

Lilmoth Dock is a short walk north-east of here. The walled part of Lilmoth lies a little further off to the north-north-west. Hereguard Plantation lies further still to the west-north-west. Bretons hold it.
This is my village, and I am Flaa Heet, its headman. Three villagers and a child live here with me, and two of them sell from stalls.
Sword ferns crowd the slope east of the village.
Lilmoth has no single ruler. A council of powerful merchants runs the town.
Lilmoth is built over shallow water, so large ships cannot dock. They anchor out, and small boats bring the goods in. The town has its own Hist tree, though no tribe of its own.
Three dead Dunmer lie at the east end of Lilmoth Dock, a man and two women. They lie unburied, and their gear is still on them.
I am Flaa Heet. I lead the families who live here, outside the walls of Lilmoth. We fish, gather leeks and keep our stores in barrels. I have no seat on the council and want none.
Wild leeks grow about forty paces off, a little east of north. The yellow mountain flower is down by the water, about fifty paces east, a little south.
I am a hatchling of Flaa Heet's village. I run errands to the barrels, and I watch the path to the dock for strangers.
Flaa Heet leads our village. Three villagers live here with him, and I am the child. Two of the villagers sell from stalls.

Lilmoth Dock is about two hundred and fifty paces north-east of here. The walled part of Lilmoth is nearly three hundred paces north-north-west. Hereguard Plantation, which Bretons hold, is about three hundred and fifty paces west-north-west.
Wild leeks grow about sixty paces north-north-east of here. Yellow mountain flower grows down by the water, about fifty paces east-south-east.
I sell from this stall, in the village of Flaa Heet. Travellers on the path to the dock buy what the village does not eat: food from the barrels and what the marsh gives.
Flaa Heet leads this village. Three villagers and a child live with him, and two of the villagers sell from stalls.
Lilmoth Dock lies north-east of here, past the village. It is a short walk. I go there only when I must.
Wild leeks grow a short walk east of the village. There are more to the north, a little further on. Yellow mountain flower grows down by the water in the east.
Four barrels stand a short walk west of the village. They hold food, and one holds common ingredients. A food barrel stands beside Flaa Heet, who leads the village.
The three dead Dunmer at the east end of Lilmoth Dock still carry their weapons and purses.
I keep the stores for this village. I fill the barrels with what the marsh gives, and I know what is in each one.
Flaa Heet leads the village. Three villagers and a child live with him. Two of the villagers sell from stalls.

Lilmoth Dock lies north-east of here. It is a short walk. The walled part of Lilmoth lies north-north-west, a little further on. Hereguard Plantation lies west-north-west, further still. Bretons hold it.
The three dead Dunmer at the east end of Lilmoth Dock still carry their weapons and purses. It is a short walk north-east of here.
Four barrels stand about thirty paces west of the village. They hold food, and one holds common ingredients.
Three dead Dunmer lie unburied at the east end of Lilmoth Dock, a short walk north-east of here. One is a man and two are women.
I keep the south stall in this village. I haggle harder than my neighbour does. I also hear what travellers say, and I pass it on.
Nobody knows who killed the three Dunmer at the east end of Lilmoth Dock, a short walk north-east of here. They were armed, and they died all the same.

Lilmoth Dock is a short walk north-east of here. Flaa Heet's village is a little further, south-west. The walled part of Lilmoth lies north-west. That is a longer walk, nearly twice as far as the village.
Three Dunmer lie dead and unburied at the east end of Lilmoth Dock, a short walk north-east of here. There is a man and two women. Go and see for yourself.
I am a sellsword, and I fight with my fists. I travel with a mage and a swordsman, and we take work as guards when the merchants of Lilmoth pay for it. Just now we have no work.
Lilmoth Dock is a short walk to the north-east. The walled part of Lilmoth is a longer walk to the north-west. Flaa Heet's village lies a short walk to the south-west.
Wild leeks grow a few paces to the north-west. Yellow mountain flower grows a few paces to the east, down by the water. A poison bloom grows a short walk to the east-north-east.
Lilmoth has no single ruler. A council of powerful merchants runs it. It has its own Hist tree, though no tribe of its own.
I am a mage for hire, and I cast fire. I keep a ward up while my companions and I travel. I chose Lilmoth for its Hist tree and its old Imperial ruins, and I read about both.

Lilmoth Dock lies north-east of here, less than a hundred paces off. Flaa Heet's village lies a little over a hundred paces to the south-west. The walled part of Lilmoth lies north-west, more than two hundred paces away.
Three dead Dunmer lie at the east end of Lilmoth Dock, about a hundred paces north-east of here. They still carry their weapons and their purses.
I fight with a blade in each hand. I also do the bargaining for the three of us.
We are three Argonian sellswords, a brawler, a fire mage and a swordsman. We stand together here on the shore track, south-west of Lilmoth Dock.
Lilmoth Dock is a short walk north-north-east of here. The village of Flaa Heet is a longer walk south-west. The walled part of Lilmoth is further still, west-north-west.
These dead trees stand along the shore, south-west of the dock. Wild leeks grow between them.
Three dead Dunmer lie unburied at the east end of the dock. They are a man and two women. It is a little further north-north-east than the dock itself.
I unloaded the small boats at that dock. I drank my wages once too often, and now I sit here and watch it.
Lilmoth Dock lies north-east of here, a short walk. Flaa Heet's village lies south-west, a much longer way. The walled part of Lilmoth lies west-north-west, further still.
Wild leeks grow a few paces north-west of here. Yellow mountain flower grows down by the water, a few paces south. A poison bloom grows east-south-east, about thirty paces off.
Three dead Dunmer lie at the east end of Lilmoth Dock, a short walk north-east of here. They still carry their weapons and purses.
I gather leeks. That is all I do here.
I do not know who killed the three Dunmer at the east end of Lilmoth Dock. It is about seventy paces north-east of here. They were armed, and they died anyway.
Wild leeks grow about twenty paces north-west of here. Yellow mountain flower grows down by the water, a dozen paces south-south-west. A poison bloom grows about forty paces east-south-east.
Three Dunmer lie dead and unburied at the east end of Lilmoth Dock, a man and two women. It is about seventy paces north-east of here.
I am a thief. I work the road to the dock with the other thief by the leeks. I know where the dead lie and what they carry, but I have not gone to see yet.
